QUOTE: If viewable, the local channel gets `delete_at` set to now, so it stays in the local DB as an archived channel. If not viewable, the current user is removed from the channel locally. ... only when not viewable: If the channel is the current one, it kicks the user out with `Events.CHANNEL_ARCHIVED`. It removes the current user from the channel.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that when archived channels are not viewable the user is removed from the channel and kicked out if it is the current one. When viewable, the channel is kept with `delete_at` set.
